import csv,hashlib,itertools,json,struct

import unicorn
from unicorn import Uc,UC_ARCH_X86,UC_MODE_16,UC_HOOK_CODE
from unicorn.x86_const import *
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];b=(R/'prior/inputs/nite3w - 110.exe').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='12fe5168783446275802e0e947898261b5eca6b88288f3a895fc1faa4c544481'
ne=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,0x3c)[0];st=ne+struct.unpack_from('<H',b,ne+0x22)[0];shift=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,ne+0x32)[0];o,n,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<4H',b,st+16);code=bytearray(b[o<<shift:(o<<shift)+n]);relocs=[]
for r in json.loads((R/'pass2/relocation_chain_sites.json').read_text()):
 if r['source_segment']==3 and 0x80f8<=r['source']<0x830a:
  assert r['type']==2 and r['flags']==0
  struct.pack_into('<H',code,r['source'],0x1000+(r['target_segment']-1)*8);relocs.append(r['source'])
listing=R/'pass19/health_listing.tsv'
if not listing.exists():listing=R/'pass18-results/listing.tsv'
checked=0
for r in csv.DictReader(listing.open(),delimiter='\t'):
 if r['function']=='1010:80f8':
  a=int(r['address'].split(':')[1],16);assert code[a:a+len(r['bytes'])//2].hex()==r['bytes'];checked+=1
assert checked>0
CS=0x1010;DS=0x1048;SS=0x9000;BASE=CS<<4;DATA=DS<<4;STACK=SS<<4
uc=Uc(UC_ARCH_X86,UC_MODE_16);uc.mem_map(0,0x100000);uc.mem_write(BASE+0x80f8,bytes(code[0x80f8:0x830a]));uc.mem_write(0x40000,b'\x90')
stubs={0x9fa2:'damage',0xb94e:'death_index',0xb6a0:'optional_helper',0x762c:'change_record',0x9f10:'reward',0xa3b6:'UI',0xb862:'reaction7'};ctx={}
for off in stubs:uc.mem_write(BASE+off,b'\xcb')
def hook(uc,at,size,user):
 if at==0x40000:ctx['stop']='return';uc.emu_stop();return
 off=at-BASE
 if off in [0x812b,0x81f8,0x8303] and ctx['prefix']:
  ctx['stop']={0x812b:'lethal',0x81f8:'subtract',0x8303:'zero'}[off];uc.emu_stop();return
 if off not in stubs:return
 name=stubs[off];ctx['calls'].append(name)
 if name=='damage':uc.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_AX,ctx['damage'])
 elif name=='death_index':uc.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_AX,2)
 elif name=='reward' and not ctx['real_reward']:uc.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_AX,ctx['award'])
 elif name=='change_record':
  sp=uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_SP);args=struct.unpack('<5HI',bytes(uc.mem_read(STACK+sp+4,14)))
  assert args==(0x1000,DS,0x2000,DS,0xbeef,0x90012 if ctx['height'] in range(1,128) else 0x90000)
 elif name=='UI':
  sp=uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_SP);assert bytes(uc.mem_read(STACK+sp+4,2))==b'\x04\x00'
for off in stubs:uc.hook_add(UC_HOOK_CODE,hook,begin=BASE+off,end=BASE+off)
for at in [0x40000,BASE+0x812b,BASE+0x81f8,BASE+0x8303]:uc.hook_add(UC_HOOK_CODE,hook,begin=at,end=at)
def w(a,v):uc.mem_write(DATA+a,struct.pack('<H',v&65535))
def setup(health,damage,status=0,prefix=True,score=0,award=0,mode=1,height=0,kind=0,real_reward=False):
 ctx.update(damage=damage,prefix=prefix,award=award,height=height,calls=[],stop=None,real_reward=real_reward)
 for reg in [UC_X86_REG_AX,UC_X86_REG_BX,UC_X86_REG_CX,UC_X86_REG_DX,UC_X86_REG_SI,UC_X86_REG_DI,UC_X86_REG_BP]:uc.reg_write(reg,0)
 for reg,val in [(UC_X86_REG_CS,CS),(UC_X86_REG_DS,DS),(UC_X86_REG_ES,DS),(UC_X86_REG_SS,SS),(UC_X86_REG_SP,0xf000),(UC_X86_REG_EFLAGS,2)]:uc.reg_write(reg,val)
 uc.mem_write(STACK+0xf000,struct.pack('<6H',0,0x4000,0x1000,DS,0x2000,DS))
 actor=bytearray([0xa5]*32);actor[0x10]=health;actor[0xb]=status;actor[0xd]=0x44;uc.mem_write(DATA+0x1000,bytes(actor))
 obj=bytearray(32);obj[4]=0;obj[6]=kind;obj[0x1a]=height;struct.pack_into('<HH',obj,0xc,0x4000,DS);uc.mem_write(DATA+0x2000,bytes(obj));uc.mem_write(DATA+0x4001,b'\x99')
 w(0x4748,0x3000);w(0x3000+0x4a+4,0xbeef);w(0x4c26,mode);uc.mem_write(DATA+0x4c16,struct.pack('<I',score))
 uc.emu_start(BASE+0x80f8,0xfffff,count=2000)
 assert ctx['stop'] is not None
 return bytes(uc.mem_read(DATA+0x1000,32))

for health,low,high in itertools.product(range(256),range(256),[0,0x12,0xff]):
 a=setup(health,low|(high<<8));expected='lethal' if health<=low else 'zero' if low==0 else 'subtract'
 assert ctx['stop']==expected
 assert a[0x10]==(0 if expected=='lethal' else health-low)
 assert a[0x12]==(8 if expected=='subtract' else 0xa5)
 assert ctx['calls']==['damage'];prefixcases+=1
reactioncases=0
for health,low,status in itertools.product([1,128,255],[0,1,127,128,255],[0,7]):
 setup(health,low,status=status);expected=['damage']+(['reaction7'] if status==7 and 0<low<health else [])
 assert ctx['calls']==expected;reactioncases+=1
lethalcases=0
for score,award,mode,height in itertools.product([0,1,65535,0xffffffff],[0,1,32767,32768,65535],[1,2],[0,1,127,128,255]):
 a=setup(50,50,prefix=False,score=score,award=award,mode=mode,height=height)
 signed=award if award<32768 else award-65536
 assert ctx['stop']=='return' and uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_SP)==0xf004
 assert a[0x10]==0 and a[0x12]==0xa5
 assert struct.unpack('<I',bytes(uc.mem_read(DATA+0x4c16,4)))[0]==(score+signed)&0xffffffff
 assert bytes(uc.mem_read(DATA+0x4001,1))==b'\x44' and uc.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_AX)&255==0x44
 assert ctx['calls']==['damage','death_index']+(['optional_helper'] if mode!=1 else [])+['change_record','reward','UI'];lethalcases+=1
uc.mem_write(BASE+0x9f10,bytes(code[0x9f10:0x9fa2]))
uc.ctl_remove_cache(BASE+0x9f10,BASE+0x9fa2)
awards={8:25,0x1a:25,9:75,10:50,0x20:50,0xb:100,0xf:100,0x10:100,0x17:100,0x1b:100,0x1c:100,0xc:250,0x1d:250,0x1e:250,0xd:150,0x12:150,0x13:150,0xe:200,0x14:200,0x18:200,0x1f:200,0x15:-1000,0x16:1000}
real_reward_cases=0
for kind,score,mode in itertools.product(range(256),[0,999,1000,0xffffffff],[1,2]):
 a=setup(50,50,prefix=False,score=score,mode=mode,kind=kind,real_reward=True)
 assert ctx['stop']=='return' and a[0x10]==0
 actual=struct.unpack('<I',bytes(uc.mem_read(DATA+0x4c16,4)))[0];expected=(score+awards.get(kind,0))&0xffffffff
 assert actual==expected,(kind,score,mode,actual,expected,ctx['calls'])
 real_reward_cases+=1
out=dict(exe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),engine='Unicorn '+unicorn.__version__,health_prefix_original_cases=prefixcases,status7_prefix_cases=reactioncases,full_lethal_branch_cases=lethalcases,full_lethal_with_original_reward_cases=real_reward_cases,type_reward_signed_values=awards,instruction_byte_checks=checked,selector_relocations_applied=relocs,relocated_body_sha256=hashlib.sha256(code[0x80f8:0x830a]).hexdigest(),runtime_game_execution=False,limits=['Damage and helpers stubbed except9F10 original reward function in final cases','Prefix execution stops after health/timer write or at zero branch','Full lethal branch checks direct writes, arguments and helper order; other helper effects excluded','Controlled valid nonaliasing pointers; no full Windows execution','Positive damage reaction branches after81F8 not executed'])
(R/'pass19/health_microexecution.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
